# Excelflow
This repository is **Excelflow**, a fork of GridCraft. Read `docs/UPSTREAM.md` first. In short:
- Never hand-edit a file that came from upstream to change branding, ids, links or icons: add the
change to `rebrand/brand.json` (or a patch in `rebrand/patches/`) and run `python3 rebrand/apply.py`,
so it survives the next upstream merge.
- Excelflow's own files are `rebrand/`, `brand/`, `docs/UPSTREAM.md`, `README.md`,
`assets/header-*.png` and `.github/workflows/release.yml` / `windows-release.yml`.
- Crate, binary and environment-variable names stay `gridcraft*` / `GRIDCRAFT_*`.
Excelflow
Excelflow is a modified version of GridCraft, made by Reach Neo as part of the FlowApps suite.
It changes the name, icon, identifiers and links and removes the Discord and ArtCraft links;
rebrand/brand.json and rebrand/patches/ list every change.
Excelflow is not affiliated with or endorsed by the ArtCraft Team. The Excelflow name and mark
(brand/, assets/app-icon/) are not covered by the license above.
# Excelflow (rebrand/apply.py): files we replace whole keep our version in a merge.
# Needs `git config merge.ours.driver true` once per clone (docs/UPSTREAM.md).
README.md merge=ours
.github/workflows/release.yml merge=ours
.github/workflows/windows-release.yml merge=ours
assets/app-icon/** merge=ours
